description: This file is a JavaScript module implementing an API client for a task backend, providing functions for authentication, note management, and user session handling, utilizing fetch API and environment variables.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in localStorage.

methods.name: authHeader
methods.description: Constructs the Authorization header with Bearer token if available.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if a token exists, indicating user authentication status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via POST /login, stores JWT token on success.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes with optional filters and sorting, protected by JWT.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified attributes, protected by JWT.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID with provided data, protected by JWT.

calls: fetch (for login, signup, fetchNotes, createNote, updateNote)
